svg.text: ENTERPRISE AI INFRASTRUCTURE · MONOREPO CODEBASE INDEXING & CALL-GRAPH RAG (#377)
Tree-sitter AST Chunking + SCIP Call-Graph + Merkle-Tree Sync vs. Line Split
AST Scope-Header Chunking + SCIP 1-Hop Call-Graph Lifts SWE Localization Recall@10 From 48.5% to 94.8% (180ms Sync)
Tier 1: Fixed-Line Split & Full Branch Re-Index
• Slices functions in half and strips parent class/import context
• Vector search alone misses cross-file callers & interface types
• Re-embeds 50,000 files on branch switch (42 min sync delay)
Tier 4: Tree-sitter cAST + SCIP Graph + Merkle
• Tree-sitter AST chunks functions with prepended Class/Import header
• Merkle-tree SHA-256 syncs only changed AST nodes in 180 ms (99.8%)
• SCIP / LSP symbol graph expands 1-hop callers/callees/types
4-Tier Enterprise Codebase Indexing Matrix (50k Files · 15M LOC · 1,000 Developers)
Tier 1 (Naive 512-Tok Line Split) : Recall@10 = 48.5% | Sync = 2520.00s | Reuse = 0.0% | Cost = $48,000/mo
Tier 2 (Tree-sitter AST + Vector) : Recall@10 = 74.2% | Sync = 45.00s | Reuse = 85.0% | Cost = $7,200/mo
Tier 3 (cAST + Trigram + Merkle) : Recall@10 = 84.6% | Sync = 0.18s | Reuse = 99.8% | Cost = $1,450/mo
Tier 4 (cAST + SCIP Graph + Merkle) : Recall@10 = 94.8% | Sync = 0.18s | Reuse = 99.8% | Cost = $1,680/mo
